Honey Mustard Mayonnaise
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:39pm

Ingredients




2 tablespoons Honey mustard
1/2 cup Low or no-fat mayonnaise

Preparation

1 1. In a small bowl combine honey mustard and mayonnaise. 2 2. Cover and refrigerate an hour for flavors to blend. 3 NOTE: A luscious combination on a "TLT" - Turkey, Lettuce and Tomato.
